verdict.rationale: Blink Shell stores user data such as hosts, keys and settings, so a data-export story is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack documents no export feature for that data in open formats. The scp/sftp/curl file-transfer tools and the open-source build option are adjacent capabilities or user-side workarounds, not a first-party data export, and a community request for host-list sync suggests config portability was lacking.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
